resources.string: That email or password is wrong.
Try again. If you forgot your password, reset it on your server.
You\'re not signed in.
Sign in again.
That password is wrong, so child mode stays on.
Try again. Only a parent can leave child mode.
That isn\'t here.
Go back and try again.
This phone isn\'t enrolled any more.
Enrol it again, or nothing gets counted.
That code isn\'t right.
Check the characters and enter it again.
That code has expired.
Make a new one on the parent\'s device.
The server couldn\'t use that.
Check what you entered and send it again.
Too much at once.
The app will send it in smaller pieces. Nothing for you to do.
This app is older than the server expects.
Update the app and the times start flowing again.
Too many tries in a row.
Wait a moment and try again.
No connection.
Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
The server took too long.
Try again in a moment.
The secure connection failed.
Check the server address and your server\'s certificate.
That answer didn\'t come from your server.
Often it\'s a guest Wi-Fi with a login page. Sign in there, then try again.
The server can\'t be reached at that address.
Check the address, and that the server is running.
No server address is set yet.
Enter your server\'s address.
Usage access is off, so nothing is being counted.
Switch it back on in Settings, under Special app access.
Notifications are off, so the ongoing notice can\'t show.
Allow notifications so it stays visible that counting is on.
Background listening isn\'t being measured.
Allow notification access in settings so music with the screen off is counted.
Saved data on this device couldn\'t be read.
Try again. If it keeps happening, sign out and back in.
An hour couldn\'t be queued.
The app keeps trying. Check there\'s still storage free on the device.
This app doesn\'t know the device\'s time zone.
Check the time zone in the device settings.
The data couldn\'t be read.
Try again. If it keeps happening, update the app.
Something went wrong on the server.
Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, look for the reference below in the server log.
The server can\'t reach its database.
Try again later. Check that the database is running.
